title: 伊莉丝·丝带礼盒
description: 暗红发伊莉丝穿高领长裙，给礼盒系丝带，身后蛛腿轮廓柔和收拢。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Elise is an adult woman with pale skin, dark red hair, ruby eyes, and a distinct spider-inspired silhouette with jointed appendages fanning behind her. Keep the elegant pointed crown and red-black palette, but dress her in a fully covering high-collared long-sleeved gown with opaque legs. Soften the spider limbs into rounded folded forms, with no fangs, exposed body, or frightening expression.
art_direction.scene: She sits at a little round table and ties a neat pale ribbon around a small gift box. One tiny friendly spider rests beside the spare ribbon spool, its simple round body and feet clearly separated. Keep the rear appendages folded close, the table uncluttered, and a soft curtain behind the character for a warm craft afternoon.
art_direction.palette: deep burgundy, charcoal purple, blush ribbon, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
